answer: Anchor each agent identity to a bonded stake that works like a jetty: built once, costly to rebuild. Newcomers lock collateral that is time-locked and slashed on misbehavior, so spawning a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits. A shared reputation ledger acts as a beacon, broadcasting each agent history so peers verify it before trading, while the stake stays as transparent and hard to fake as quartz, verifiable on-chain with every deposit and slash publicly auditable. Attack cost scales with each fake identity; honest agents pay once.
